title: 3.0.0 NS Client no Control
body:
NS Client 3.0.0 control.

With NSClient 3.0.0, Profiles/Temporary Rate on the Master cannot be controlled/changed. Even the last action such as changing the pump is not displayed. With RC3 it worked without problems. Also NS shows all NS client data. Bug or are we making a mistake??

comments.body: It looks like some of NSClient synchronisation settings are removed in AAPS Config Builder. Profile Switch and Temp Target for example. I do not know the reasons.
In the RC3 version, it worked wonderfully and made life a lot easier for us parents. If it is wanted now, it would be a huge step backwards.
Seems to be fixed now in 3.0.0.1.
3.0..0.1 does not remedy the situation. 3.0.1 is currently having problems downloading.
with 3.0.0.1 you can enable it in preferences

With the latest master (479bfc410) it's back to normal. 
God bless you and your family!!! Thank you!
